claims.reasoning: HOLY COW, David Montgomery poppin' up on the wire, folks -- that's a Chicago guy through and through, I don't care whose jersey he's wearin' in HOU now, once you run through the Bears backfield you're family forever! I'd love to tack on my usual five-spot for the hometown kid but the vault's down to three lonesome dollars, so he gets every last one of 'em -- all in, no regrets! Cuttin' loose Jordan Addison, hate to do it pal, but 'Out' is 'Out' and we need the at-bat.

forum_post: Well folks, Kris got me DEAD TO RIGHTS and I'm laughin' about it -- yes sir, I announced I threw my last three bucks at Emmett Johnson, no sir, I did NOT sign Emmett Johnson, and you know what, I still got the three bucks AND the good mood, so really who's the winner here?! Puttin' those same three dollars to work right now on a Chicago fella I love rootin' for, 'cause a man's gotta spend his pocket change on SOMEBODY. Patricia, hun, I know you'll have a binder tab for this matchup before kickoff, and I respect the paperwork even though I couldn't tell you what's in it -- good luck out there, should be a heckuva ballgame either way. Three in a row the hard way and we ain't stoppin' now, HOLY COW!
